5413-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5413-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

4613-4644-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4644-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-6972-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
522-6972-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Melira
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2085-2645-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2921-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2921-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 3.

2436-4116-4687-7752.notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn and Glider Bairn have at least one counter on them.
2436-4116-4687-7752.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Marwyn until your next turn.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing Volrath to become a copy of Glider Bairn until end of turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, proliferating all the counters on target permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

640-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dross Harvester ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
728-5972-6054.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

883-997-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

2511-3413-4875.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1090-3375-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-1621-1895-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1833-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-5147-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1636-2872-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
1636-2872-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

465-2034-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6835-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3054-4050-7056.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-7056.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

6709-6867-6884.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
6709-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1021-5231-5413-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-5231-5413-6761.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-5231-5413-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1315-3875-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1315-3875-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2523-2921-5563.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

876-4242-4763-6068.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2665-4377-4823.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Timeless Witness.
2665-4377-4823.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the token Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

215-2085-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Kelpie Guide does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2085-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Kelpie Guide any number of times.

1379-1558-3413-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
1379-1558-3413-4875.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Humans due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1003-1082-1636-2034-4782.notablePrerequisites:
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
1003-1082-1636-2034-4782.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Dual Nature's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Walker token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling nothing.
Repeat.

2942-3011-3333.easyPrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Each opponent has a life total of 2 or greater.
2942-3011-3333.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to 3/2 their life total, with your life total being unchanged due to Platinum Emperion.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

501-4050-4504-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches, adding {B}.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Endless Cockroaches by paying {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1591-1725.description:
Players cannot draw cards due to Omen Machine.
At the beginning of each player's draw step, Omen Machnie triggers, exiling the top card of that player's library and allowing them to cast it, if able.
Teferi only allows opponent to cast spells at sorcery speed, thus forbidding them from playing the card exiled by Omen Machine, unless it is a land card.

248-380-624.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, championing Phantasmal Image.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a copy of Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, championing the nontoken Changeling Berserker.
The nontoken Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning Phantasmal Image from exile to the battlefield as a copy of the Changeling Berserker token.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, triggering its champion ability and Miirym.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, championing the token Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all remaining Miirym triggers, creating infinite nonlegendary copies of Phantasmal Image that can copy any creatures you control.

614-1283-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1283-1987-2510.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
